rules.description: <worker>: human check (Turnstile managed challenge) on page loads before sign-in; signed-in visitors (the site's session cookie), upload API, static files and WhatsApp's link previews (the sign-in page's card) excluded
rules.expression: (http.host eq "<domain>" and http.request.method eq "GET" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and not http.request.uri.path.extension in {"js" "css" "png" "ico" "txt" "svg" "jpg" "jpeg" "webp" "woff2" "webmanifest"} and not http.cookie contains "<worker>_session=" and not http.user_agent contains "WhatsApp/")
